routes.name: Refrigerated

activities.name: Feed the Hunters
activities.description: A repeatable refrigerated processing loop that awards Trucking XP while converting Food Shipments into Hunting EXP Tokens.
activities.notes: Known from live TT testing to award Trucking XP per process. Your actual XP/hr depends heavily on processing speed, travel/restock time, and active EXP bonuses.
steps: Use the Refrigerated or Master trucking sub-job.
Bring Fridge: Food Shipment to the Feed the Hunters transformer.
Each process uses 10 Food Shipments.
Repeat the recipe continuously while timing a benchmark.
Use the site's Stop & calculate button after a realistic session to record your actual XP/hr.

activities.name: Logging
activities.description: Logging Camp → Sawmill → Sawdust/Planks → LS Port Export or storage.
steps: Pick up Logs at a Logging Camp.
Take Logs to the Sawmill.
Process into Sawdust or Planks.
Export at LS Port Export or store for advanced routes.

activities.name: Recycled Materials
activities.description: Recycling Center → Sorting Facility → Scrap Plastic / Aluminum / Tin → exports or LS Foundry.
steps: Pick up Recycled Trash at the Recycling Center.
Process it at the Sorting Facility.
Export Scrap Plastic at McKenzie Export.
Refine Aluminum/Tin at LS Foundry, then export refined materials at LS Port Export.

activities.name: Refrigerated Trucking
activities.description: Food cargo routes using vegetables, dairy, meat/fish and airline-meal related processing.
steps: Switch to Refrigerated or Master at Trucking HQ/PDA.
Choose a refrigerated cargo chain.
Load the highest-capacity rig you can use.
Run a full pickup → process/delivery loop and benchmark it.

activities.name: Petrochemical / Military
activities.description: Crude Oil and Raw Gas feed petrochemical production, which is then used by Military trucking.
steps: Switch to Petrochemical or Master.
Collect Crude Oil / Raw Gas.
Process petrochemical cargo.
Switch/use Military steps as required to continue the chain.
Benchmark a complete repeatable loop, not only one transformer.

activities.name: Jewelry
activities.description: Quarry Rubble + Recycled Electronics → Jewelry → Jewelry Store.
steps: Collect Quarry Rubble.
Collect Recycled Electronics.
Process the materials into Jewelry.
Sell at the Jewelry Store.
Benchmark the full material-to-sale loop.

activities.name: Batteries
activities.description: Quarry Rubble + Recycled Trash + Toxic Waste feed the battery chain.
steps: Collect Quarry Rubble.
Collect Recycled Trash.
Collect Toxic Waste.
Run the battery processing chain.
Benchmark a repeatable batch including restock time.

activities.name: Concrete
activities.description: Quarry Rubble + Logs + Unfiltered Water + Toxic Waste → Concrete → Alta Construction Site.
steps: Collect Quarry Rubble, Logs, Unfiltered Water and Toxic Waste.
Process the concrete recipe.
Deliver/sell Concrete at Alta Construction Site.
Benchmark several batches to smooth out travel variance.

activities.name: Illegal Trucking
activities.description: Pill Capsules, Defibkit and Pills routes using Methamphetamine.
steps: Switch to Illegal or Master trucking.
Acquire Methamphetamine at Liquor Ace.
Choose Pills, Full Pill Capsules, or Defibkit chain.
Benchmark the same chain for at least several minutes.

activities.name: House Route
activities.description: The ultimate advanced route combining materials from the other advanced and Premium trucking chains.
steps: Prepare outputs from the required advanced routes.
Prepare outputs from the Premium routes.
Bring the required materials to the House Construction Site.
Craft Houses and benchmark a realistic full-cycle batch.

activities.name: Vehicle Shipments
activities.description: Craft vehicle parts and assemble Vehicle Shipments at the Vehicle Factory.
steps: Craft Car Battery, Chassis, Traction Battery, Vehicle Framework and Wheels at Vehicle Parts.
Gather the remaining required materials for the desired vehicle.
Craft the shipment at the Vehicle Factory.
Benchmark only if using this as an XP grind, since material preparation is substantial.
